params.name: input
params.label: Input
params.description: The surface whose point attribute spreads out over it.

params.name: attribute
params.label: Attribute
params.description: The point attribute that diffuses; must already exist. Floats, integers and vectors, each component on its own; integers stay whole.

params.name: rate
params.label: Rate
params.description: How fast the value spreads, in square world units per frame: a spike widens by about the square root of four times Rate each frame. Measured over the surface, so it does not change when the mesh is retessellated.

params.name: rate_by
params.label: Rate By
params.description: A point attribute that scales Rate where it lies, so the value spreads faster in some places than in others. Empty spreads it evenly; a name that is not an attribute is an error.

params.name: per_frame
params.label: Per Frame
params.description: Inside a simulation, makes Rate a rate per frame, so the substep count does not change how far a frame spreads. Off spreads a whole frame's worth every substep.

params.name: group
params.label: Group
params.description: Only points in this group change. Points outside it hold their values and feed or drain the ones beside them, like a fixed temperature at the edge of a plate. Empty changes every point.
